value: Netherwing magic disguises the seeker as a Dragonmaw recruit; Illidari papers are delivered to Mor’ghor, opening the taskmaster route.
editorNote: The disguise and warning are quest mechanics/dialogue. The story does not claim every Dragonmaw accepts the deception or that the infiltration has already changed the operation. Source pages are secondary quest-text locators; exact original client/build comparison remains open.
